name: PROBE-1-a-named-value-export-is-back-on-the-entrypoint
note: THE BUG THIS PROBE EXISTS FOR, restored. In a module Worker every named export of the entrypoint is read as an ENTRYPOINT, so workerd refuses to start over a constant - and the node suite stays green BECAUSE it imports those very names. If this survives, the probe has stopped asking the one question it was written to ask.

name: PROBE-2-the-R2-binding-is-not-the-one-the-code-asks-for
note: AUDIT-312 F4's whole point: a binding that is ABSENT does not crash. `env.SAVES` undefined answers `no-storage`, which reaches a player as "Cloud saves are unavailable right now" - with a green suite and a green deploy behind it, because the suite hands the Worker its own env and never reads this file.

name: PROBE-3-the-hash-cost-leaves-a-Workers-CPU-budget
note: The suite gets SLOWER and stays green; only a real workerd says whether a registration still fits the budget. The probe measures it rather than assuming it, which is the second thing it claims to prove.

name: PROBE-4-a-migration-stops-applying
old: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS saves (
new:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS saves (
  this_is_not_sql_at_all !!!,
note: The suite applies the migrations to node:sqlite and would catch this too - but the probe applies them through WRANGLER'S OWN LEDGER, which is the thing the deploy runs and the thing ACC1-CI changed the pair of `d1 execute` lines for.
